verdict.rationale: Datadog markets Cloud Cost Management for attributing cloud/usage spend by tag, service, or team, which could address SRE cost-attribution needs [datadog-docs-15], but this covers cloud-provider costs rather than Datadog's own observability bill, and a long-time customer reports losing a ~$6M/yr account specifically due to 'lack of billing transparency and an incompetent account rep' who angered finance [datadog-comm-6] — a concrete hands-on contradiction of the claim that spend is easily visible/attributable. Missing for 10: dedicated documentation on tracking Datadog's own usage/billing per team or service, evidence of spike alerting on Datadog spend itself, and independent corroboration that billing transparency issues have been resolved.
